eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Klamath, OR; at 2:01 PM on AUG 17, 2026 Effective until 5:01 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Correction: The previous notification was intended to correct overlapping, conflicting data in the emergency notification system. No new Level 3 evacuation notices have been issued. There have been no changes to evacuation zones since the downgrades issued this morning.
